Incompressible materials such as this are best represented by a hyperelastic material model such as Mooney-Rivlin. Alternatively, the Poisson's ratio can be modified slightly to a value just below 0.5 provided that the Young's and shear moduli values are appropriately adjusted to maintain the relationship E=2G(1+NU).

Activates improved post-processing features and a new visual style for Linear Static Stress, Thermal and Thermal Stress Studies.

Investigate whether your model can be manufactured, or how it may perform under ‘real life’ conditions, before physically manufacturing anything. Use the Simulation Extension to simulate a variety of conditions, to help you validate and optimize your designs.

Two ways to run your simulations:
  •  Per Use – Use tokens or cloud credits each time you solve a study.
  •  By Subscription – Solve numerous simulations across multiple analysis types while on an active subscription.

Unlock the potential of simulation and generative design technologies to optimize your designs, enhance performance, and improve manufacturing efficiency. Gain valuable insights into your design performance with different simulation study types and explore objective-based design alternatives.
